create.name: Be Here Now Network
create.bio:
Be Here Now Network is a non-profit podcast network that grew out of Ram Dass's wish to pass on what he had received from his guru, Neem Karoli Baba. It takes its name from his book and aphorism and works alongside the Ram Dass Love Serve Remember Foundation. Its YouTube channel, running since 2016, carries the video versions of its shows together with short clips cut from archive talks.

The network hosts around twenty series. Some are built from recordings of Ram Dass, Alan Watts and J. Krishnamurti; others are presented by living teachers, among them Jack Kornfield (Heart Wisdom), Joseph Goldstein (Insight Hour), Sharon Salzberg (Metta Hour), Krishna Das (Pilgrim Heart) and Raghu Markus, whose Mindrolling interviews have run for hundreds of episodes. Other strands include Omid Safi's Sufi Heart, Robert Svoboda's Living with Reality and The Spirit Underground with Spring Washam and Lama Rod Owens. The material centres on meditation, devotion, service and facing death with awareness, and it is free to stream, supported by listener donations.

free_resources.title: Ram Dass – Here and Now Podcast
free_resources.description: Weekly episodes drawn from Ram Dass's recorded talks across several decades, on devotion, service, dying and his years with Neem Karoli Baba. Free to stream on the site.

free_resources.title: Jack Kornfield – Heart Wisdom Podcast
free_resources.description: Jack Kornfield's free podcast of dharma talks, guided practices and conversations from the Buddhist insight tradition.

free_resources.title: Joseph Goldstein – Insight Hour Podcast
free_resources.description: Talks and question-and-answer sessions by Joseph Goldstein, including a long series working through the Satipatthana Sutta on the foundations of mindfulness.

free_resources.title: Sharon Salzberg – Metta Hour Podcast
free_resources.description: Sharon Salzberg's podcast of conversations and short teachings centred on loving-kindness practice, free to listen to.
